items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's what I thought. John Hand Sr. was named after him. That's right.

ctx.x: Well, the whole family was musical. The whole family. Mother, father, sister, brothers. All the whole family was musical. What was your father's name? What did he play? John Hand.
That's what I thought. John Hand Sr. was named after him. That's right.
What did he play? All instruments. Oh really? All instruments.
